rule.method: Q-learning in its batch form with a linear Q-function and n-step targets, fitted on the choices made by lot: see the top of tools/learned_dispatch.py
rule.cost_in_words: what a late AGV holds up: at every reading, one for each quay crane with a container to hand over and no AGV there, one for each export or truck job with no AGV at its pickup yet, and 0.2 for each AGV driving to a pickup
